answer: The gatehouse is Comethunter coma trial attested before the celestial record. Passing it takes 5-year night-watch service, 44 supervised sightings, field exam, annual record dues, and every alias must pass alone. Minutes add up the same way: 13 for one, 5252 for 404, and the farm pays in afternoons it never gets back. Trace the fable to its office, trace the grove to its payer, and trace the bridge to its year: the trail is the test. One seat, one proof, one price: the farm cannot buy in bulk.
